From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & procurement next steps — stakeholder matrix + onboarding asks

Hi Will / Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so procurement can run this with your teams: 

Summary (from our discovery)
- Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Will Harris (VP Product) — prioritizes latency, reliability, and data controls.
- Key decision criteria: API latency target <= 200ms P95 for demo workloads; VPC/private deployment option for PHI; SOC 2 Type II compliance; predictable per-token costs.
- Primary procurement path: Vendor Intake -> Legal review -> PO issuance -> Onboarding/Platform enablement.

Procurement asks for Aurora to confirm:
1) PO owner (who signs the PO / procurement contact) and invoice routing (AP email).
2) Any additional vendor docs required for onboarding (W-9, COI, vendor questionnaire).
3) Expected internal SLA for legal review (typical #weeks) and any special contracting terms (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps).

What I'm attaching (to speed things up)
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fill & return)
- vendor_requirements.xlsx (a short checklist: W-9, COI, banking details)

Next steps / proposed timeline
- Elaine: can you confirm PO owner and AP routing by EOD Thursday?
- We can run a 30-min procurement-only call next week (propose Tue 9/21 or Wed 9/22) to walk through the vendor intake and sample PO routing.
- Once we have the intake form + W-9 + COI, our finance team can return a sample invoice routing and a sample PO template. Onboarding generally takes ~3–4 weeks after PO.

If helpful, Ben (cc'd) can prepare a redlined MSA to shorten legal back-and-forth.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0178

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), vendor_requirements.xlsx
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@aurorahealth.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & procurement next steps — stakeholder matrix + onboarding asks

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from procurement side: 

- PO owner / procurement contact: Procurement Ops (me, Elaine Park) will shepherd the PO. Please send any sample PO templates to ap-invoices@aurorahealth.com.
- Invoice routing: ap-invoices@aurorahealth.com (net 30 standard). We prefer invoices sent as PDF to that address with a PO number in the subject line.
- Required vendor docs: W-9, Certificate of Insurance (COI), completed vendor intake questionnaire. We also ask for bank account verification for ACH.
- Legal review: expect ~10 business days on standard MSAs; faster if we get a completed vendor questionnaire and if the commercial terms are within our template. If there are unusual indemnity/data clauses we will need in-house counsel review which can add time.

I'll loop Legal if we hit any non-standard terms: legal@aurorahealth.com. For your planning: if we receive the intake form + W-9 + COI this week, target timeline is legal review (by 9/29) then PO issuance the following week (week of 10/4).

Attached: completed_vendor_requirements_template.xlsx (I filled the sections we typically need). Please also provide your W-9 and insurance cert.

Thanks — can do the procurement-only sync next Tue 9/21 10:00am PT if that works for your team.

Best,
Elaine Park
Procurement Ops Manager
Aurora Health
elaine.park@aurorahealth.com
